page_title: PSG 3-0 TOU | PSG v Toulouse 22/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+6' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Now PSG have a corner.
90+5' Toulouse take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+4' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Toulouse.
90+4' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+1' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Randal Kolo Muani slips the ball through to Vitinha (PSG), and he darts into the box to unleash a strong shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 3:0.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.

90' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Toulouse force their opponents to concede a corner.
89' The game has come to an end for Umit Akdag. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse).
87' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
87' Toulouse are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
84' 2 - 0 Goal! Lucas Beraldo (PSG) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 2:0.
84' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
84' PSG are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. PSG earn a corner.
84' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
83' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Marco Asensio (PSG). The linesman points to the corner flag, PSG are going to take it.
81' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) coming on for Bradley Barcola.
80' Kang-In Lee (PSG) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
79' Marco Asensio (PSG) is caught offside!
78' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Cristian Casseres is replaced by Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Frank Magri (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch so that Joshua King can be given a rest.
77' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
75' Gael Angoula shows the yellow card to Aron Donnum (Toulouse) for a heavy challenge.

74' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fabian Ruiz (PSG) comes onto the pitch for Ousmane Dembele.
72' Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
71' Toulouse failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

70' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Toulouse force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
69' Shots on target – 6:1.
65' Wonderful movement by PSG. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
64' Substitution. Yann Gboho makes way for Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
64' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Warren Kamanzi will be replaced by Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse).
63' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
61' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matvey Safonov intercepts the ball.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kang-In Lee (PSG) replaces Desire Doue.
59' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
58' Marco Asensio (PSG) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
57' The goal by PSG won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
56' Wait! Referee Gael Angoula has indicated he is going to review the PSG goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
55' Marco Asensio fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) inside the box and he sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 2:0.
53' This shall not pass! Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
52' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
51' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
49' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
48' The referee points to the corner flag and PSG will take a corner.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.

47' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Guillaume Restes! It will be a corner kick for PSG.
46' Luis Enrique has made a change at the break. Vitinha has come on in place of Yoram Zague (PSG).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.

45+2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. PSG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' The free kick from long range, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
43' A yellow card for a tackle by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse). Gael Angoula doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
42' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
39' Wonderful movement by PSG. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

35' 1 - 0 1:0. Joao Neves (PSG) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a great first-timer into the bottom left corner. What an amazing finish! Guillaume Restes did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Achraf Hakimi provided the assistance.
34' Bradley Barcola (PSG) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the right post, but Guillaume Restes has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
33' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
33' Gael Angoula blows his whistle after Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to PSG, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
31' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
30' PSG keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
28' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

28' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Joshua King (Toulouse) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
26' A pass into the penalty area from Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is intercepted by the defence.
25' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
22' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Guillaume Restes.
22' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) serves up a nice cross, but Guillaume Restes punches the ball away.
21' Desire Doue (PSG) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
20' Toulouse exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
18' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
16' Toulouse show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
15' Milan Skriniar (PSG) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Gael Angoula blows for a foul.
13' Desire Doue (PSG) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
12' PSG showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.

10' PSG slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
8' The ball is out of play. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner.
7' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) will deliver the corner kick.
7' Marco Asensio (PSG) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
6' Gael Angoula blows for a foul after Yann Gboho (Toulouse) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
4' Bradley Barcola (PSG) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
2' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' The referee signals a free kick from long distance for Toulouse.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! PSG will take the kick-off.
Gael Angoula will officiate today.
